final: SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count, COUNT(fa.film_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) AS fraction_of_total, COUNT(fa.film_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) - (1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actor)) AS difference_from_average_fraction FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY difference_from_average_fraction DESC LIMIT 10
